Hi Sofia — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary from discovery
- Primary pilot: analytics-driven document ingestion + semantic search for customer support KB.
- Constraints: HIPAA-adjacent customer data, strict RBAC, need for private VPC deployment for pilot.
- Success metric: 95th perc latency < 400ms for search flows at 50 concurrent users.

Suggested next step
- 60–75 minute technical deep dive with our infra/SE team to validate architecture and confirm any redlines. Vanessa will jump in for config and quantization tradeoffs. Camila will surface procurement/security timelines.

Please let me know preferred windows next week (PST). My initial proposed slots: 
- Tue 20 Feb, 10:00–11:15 AM PT
- Wed 21 Feb, 1:30–2:45 PM PT

If neither works, share 2–3 times that fit your team. I attached a short MVP requirements doc and a draft mutual action plan to help prep (high level).

Attachments: Argentum_MVP_requirements.pdf; RGW_mutual_action_plan.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
